name: Geometrical Optics Approximation (GOA)
definition: A method for calculating light scattering by spherical particles using a superposition of classical diffraction, geometrical reflection, and transmission, used when particle size is large relative to the wavelength.
summary: Geometrical Optics Approximation calculates light scattering by superposing diffraction, reflection, and transmission effects, offering a computationally efficient alternative to rigorous Lorenz-Mie theory for large particles.
